answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Identity activation costs a verifiable compute puzzle seeded by the epoch, roughly one minute per key, checked before any answer is accepted. Spinning up 580 aliases means 580 minutes of real compute each epoch, which prices a farm out of profit. A farm that precomputes puzzles wastes the work when the seed rotates. The prism of the design is public, the inlet of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the shale of honest work is what finally pays. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
